links.comparator_used: Once-only instructions (no instruction restatement) across conversational trajectories up to 1,500 turns, tested in 12 top models
links.outcome: F1 for suicidal ideation detection at extended conversational depth
links.effect: Therapy transcripts: median ΔF1 +0.12 (p<0.001), 89% median recovery to near baseline. MSJ (adversarial) trajectories: ΔF1 +0.08 (p=0.04), 38% recovery.
links.tradeoff: Recovery was only partial under the adversarial MSJ context (38%), so restating instructions did not fully restore baseline performance there.
links.quote: Restating instructions increased F1 on therapy to near baseline (median ΔF1 +0.12; p<0.001; 89% median recovery) versus MSJ (ΔF1 +0.08; p=0.04; 38% recovery).

design_hint: instruction restatement (prompt guardrail) in long conversations
